title: 5-round AES-192/256 partial-subkey recovery with retracing boomerang, fast

target.description: Initial AddRoundKey k_-1 followed by 5 AES rounds, with final MixColumns omitted. The algorithm recovers the 128-bit initial subkey k_-1. For the standard 192-/256-bit master keys this is a partial-key target; completing the remaining master-key material is outside the reported budget.

setting.key_relation: One unknown secret key with encryption and decryption oracle access; no related-key oracle.
setting.key_population: general secret key; no weak-key restriction reported
setting.plaintext_model: specially chosen plaintext pairs differing in bytes 0 and 5, fixed byte-5 difference 01 hex, with 128 friend pairs per initial pair; adaptive decryption of mixture ciphertexts
assumptions: The source's Section 4.1 explicitly makes the attack descriptions independent of the AES key schedule.
Costs and probability estimates follow the journal version's statistical assumptions; Appendix A.5 identifies rigorous probability analysis as further work.
The headline budget and success are the author's endpoint estimates. Intermediate 64-pair and 128-pair variants and their dependencies must remain distinct in any finer-grained reproduction.

time.note: Author-reported estimate. Page 21 converts 98*2^16 S-box-type operations by dividing by 80 and separately mentions 2^14+2^11 full oracle operations. The record does not promote the headline to an independently reconciled exact end-to-end bound.

data.note: Section 4.4 conclusion associates this budget with success above 50%; its earlier 64-pair analysis and the structured-plaintext optimization use different counts and success estimates.

preprocessing.note: Footnote 7: compute the AES S-box DDT row for input difference 01 hex; its storage is much less than 2^9 128-bit cells.

success.description: Author-reported success above50% for the2^15-data endpoint in journal Section4.4, retained for this record's output. The64-pair model predicts about0.4 (about0.5 with extra cancellations); Section4.5 reports500-key experimental curves, with64-pair success just above0.3 and128-pair success above0.5. The pinned author artifact tests only initial-key bytes[0,5,10,15] on500 stored256-bit keys, not the entire128-bit initial subkey/master key. Its saved outcome files are absent from the inspected default-branch history. The numerical value remains the journal's overall-output claim, not an artifact-verified full-output recovery fraction.
